## 0.1.0

* Add `ExpressiveLinearProgressIndicator` — Material 3–style wavy linear progress (determinate & indeterminate), aligned with Compose `LinearWavyProgressIndicator` behavior (track, gap, stop, theme integration).
* Add `ExpressiveLoadingIndicatorStyle` (`filled` / `outlined`) and `strokeWidth` for the morphing circular indicator.
* Improve scale inset for outlined strokes so paths are not clipped.
* Example app: full Flutter template with demo (including Riverpod-driven sliders for linear demos).

## 0.0.1

* Initial release of `ExpressiveLoadingIndicator` — morphing circular loading indicator ported from Android Material 3.
